Checks company +0x1b8 and global map records for +0xfc/+0xf4 equal to a value, with active +0xa4 and owner filters.

Scans stride-0x28 records at +0x9c and List_Adds cell IDs within param_4 on both axes, up to param_3 entries.

Counts records in +0x48 map whose byte +0x11 is zero.

Scans all six players and sums one of eight four-field groups selected by DAT_0056b270, returning the global maximum.
